q: What is the carbon footprint of processed millets such as ragi or jowar?
title: Millet processing footprint
short: Processing usually adds cleaning, destoning, dehulling and milling electricity, plus packaging and transport. The farm stage should come from farmer data or a database figure. Report per kg of finished flour or grain, and say whether bran and husk were sold.
audience: Millet processors, FPOs and food brands

ul: Dehulling or polishing, for some millets.

p: Bran and husk sold on can share the emissions by a stated allocation rule.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
